allowance(address,address).details: Returns the remaining number of tokens that `spender` will be allowed to spend on behalf of `owner` through {transferFrom}. This is zero by default. This value changes when {approve} or {transferFrom} are called.

approve(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-approve}. NOTE: If `value` is the maximum `uint256`, the allowance is not updated on `transferFrom`. This is semantically equivalent to an infinite approval. Requirements: - `spender` cannot be the zero address.

balanceOf(address).details: Returns the value of tokens owned by `account`.

decimals().details: Returns the number of decimals used to get its user representation. For example, if `decimals` equals `2`, a balance of `505` tokens should be displayed to a user as `5.05` (`505 / 10 ** 2`). Tokens usually opt for a value of 18, imitating the relationship between Ether and Wei. This is the default value returned by this function, unless it's overridden. NOTE: This information is only used for _display_ purposes: it in no way affects any of the arithmetic of the contract, including {IERC20-balanceOf} and {IERC20-transfer}.

name().details: Returns the name of the token.

symbol().details: Returns the symbol of the token, usually a shorter version of the name.

totalSupply().details: Returns the value of tokens in existence.

transfer(address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transfer}. Requirements: - `to` cannot be the zero address. - the caller must have a balance of at least `value`.

transferFrom(address,address,uint256).details: See {IERC20-transferFrom}. Skips emitting an {Approval} event indicating an allowance update. This is not required by the ERC. See {xref-ERC20-_approve-address-address-uint256-bool-}[_approve]. NOTE: Does not update the allowance if the current allowance is the maximum `uint256`. Requirements: - `from` and `to` cannot be the zero address. - `from` must have a balance of at least `value`. - the caller must have allowance for ``from``'s tokens of at least `value`.

FEE_BPS().notice: The liquidity providers' fee on every swap, in basis points: 4% at launch (R9.28).

MAX_DRIFT_BPS().notice: The most the price now may be below its mean over the window, against a buyer of UNB, for         `steadyQuoteUnbOut` to quote, in basis points (OPEN, owner-tunable; 1%, the impact Settlement's own swaps         are held to).

MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY().notice: Shares the first deposit locks forever, so the pool never empties to a price one wei can set.

WINDOW_BLOCKS().notice: The blocks the reference price is averaged over (OPEN, owner-tunable): a price pushed against a buyer by         `d` must be held about `(1 − 1%/d)` of them before Settlement buys at it (`Twap`).

addLiquidity(uint256,uint256,uint256,add.notice: Adds liquidity at the pool's current ratio, taking at most `usdcMax` and `unbMax` and minting shares to         `to`. The first deposit sets the price. Of the two amounts, the one that buys fewer shares binds; the         other is taken only in proportion, rounded up in the pool's favour.

meanPrice().notice: The pool's price averaged over the last `WINDOW_BLOCKS` blocks or a little more, each block at the price         it began at (UNB per USDC, a 64-bit fraction); zero until the pool has been priced a whole window.

meanQuoteUnbOut(uint256).notice: The UNB `usdcIn` buys at the pool's mean price over its window, with no fee and no price impact: zero         while there is no mean. What the route-coin bounties value their use cap at (`IUnbPoolMean`).

quoteUnbOut(uint256).notice: The UNB `swapUsdcForUnb(usdcIn, …)` would pay right now, after the pool's fee.

quoteUsdcIn(uint256).notice: The least USDC that buys at least `unbOut` UNB right now, after the pool's fee;         `type(uint256).max` when the pool can't pay that much UNB at any price.

quoteUsdcOut(uint256).notice: The USDC `swapUnbForUsdc(unbIn, …)` would pay right now, after the fee.

removeLiquidity(uint256,uint256,uint256,.notice: Burns `shares` of the caller's and pays `to` their part of both reserves, rounded down in the pool's         favour, fees earned included.

reserveUsdc().notice: The pool's USDC reserve, as it stands now. A burn batch's cap reads the steady one (`steadyReserveUsdc`).

startOfBlock().notice: The reserves as this block began.

steadyQuoteUnbOut(uint256).notice: `quoteUnbOut`, or zero when the price now gives a buyer of UNB less than its mean over the window         (`meanPrice`) by more than MAX_DRIFT_BPS, or there is no mean yet.

steadyReserveUsdc().notice: The pool's USDC reserve as it stood in an earlier block, or now if that is less: what Settlement sizes a         burn batch or a waiting swap by (R4.6). Nothing a transaction does to the pool raises it.

swapUnbForUsdc(uint256,uint256,address).notice: The other way, for anyone: sells exactly `unbIn` UNB for at least `minUsdcOut` USDC.

swapUsdcForUnb(uint256,uint256,address).notice: Takes exactly `usdcIn` USDC from the caller and pays `to` the UNB it buys, at least `minUnbOut`, or         reverts. The caller approves the pool for `usdcIn` first.

usdc().notice: The USDC this pool trades. Settlement refuses a pool whose pair isn't its own.
